create_empty_hub_dataset_repo: create a temporary dataset repository on the HuggingFace Hub with an optional prefix and gated access
delete_hub_dataset_repo: delete a dataset repository from the HuggingFace Hub by its repo ID
TemporaryDataset_allocate_release: allocate and release a temporary dataset resource on the HuggingFace Hub with gated or private settings
fetch_bot_discussion: fetch the bot discussion details for a given dataset on the HuggingFace Hub
close_discussion: close a discussion on a dataset by its discussion number on the HuggingFace Hub
